name: NEU Surface Defect Database
description: Hot-rolled steel strip surface defect database comprising 1,800 grayscale industrial images across six representative defect categories (crazing, inclusion, patches, pitted surface, rolled-in scale, and scratches) with 300 samples per class. Created by Northeastern University (China), supporting both image-level classification (NEU-CLS) and Pascal VOC bounding-box defect detection (NEU-DET).

provenance.collection_method: High-speed line-scan camera capturing surface images of moving hot-rolled steel strips in a steel manufacturing plant.
provenance.curation_notes: Each image is cropped to 200x200 pixels. NEU-CLS provides classification labels while NEU-DET provides bounding-box coordinates for each defect instance.
